Q2

flight1 <- flights |> filter(month == 1)

dist_tbl <- flight1 |>
  group_by(carrier) |>
  summarise(
    mean_distance = mean(distance),
    sd_distance = sd(distance)
  )
dist_tbl <- dist_tbl |> arrange(mean_distance)
head(dist_tbl)

Q3

NA will be shown when there is only one observation in the data set, hence the SD is not valid (divisible by 0 error), such as the case with carrier OO

However, the standard deviation can be 0, as is seen by carrier YV which is observed 46 times in the data set.

Flights2 <- flight1 |>
  filter(carrier == "OO" | carrier=="YV") |>
  count(carrier)


Flights2
# A tibble: 2 × 2

  <chr>   <int>
1 OO          1
2 YV         46

Q5

flightsDelay <- flights |>
  mutate(Q6 = ifelse((dep_delay>0 & arr_delay<=0),1,0)
    )|>
  summarize(
    proportion = mean(Q6, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

Q6

airlines <- as_tibble(airlines)
flights4 <- flights |>
  mutate(
    flightPath = str_c(origin, dest, sep = "-")
    )|> 
      group_by(flightPath) |> 
        mutate(carrier_count = n_distinct(carrier)) |> 
          ungroup() |> 
            filter(carrier_count > 1)|>
              left_join(airlines |> select(carrier, name), by = "carrier")
##OUTPUT
#6.1
head(flights4$flightPath)
[1] "JFK-MIA" "LGA-ATL" "EWR-ORD" "EWR-FLL" "LGA-IAD" "JFK-MCO"
#6.2


AirlineDelay <- flights4|>
  group_by(flightPath,name)|>
  summarise(
    meanDly = mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

##6.3

Best_Worst_Arr_Delay <- AirlineDelay |> 
  group_by(flightPath) |> 
  summarise(
    max_ave_delay = max(meanDly, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_name = name[which.max(meanDly)],
    min_ave_delay = min(meanDly, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_name = name[which.min(meanDly)]
  )
Largest_diff <- Best_Worst_Arr_Delay|>
  mutate(
    dif = max_ave_delay+min_ave_delay
  )|>
  summarize(
    max_diff = max(dif, na.rm = TRUE),
    FlightPath = flightPath[which.max(dif)]
  )
Largest_diff
# A tibble: 1 × 2
  max_diff FlightPath
     <dbl> <chr>     
1     129. JFK-ATL

ExpressJet has an exceptionally long expected arrival delay time, this is likely because it is a budget airline.
